home.title: So you're in conflict.
home.lede: One question at a time. Take your time.
home.therapistLine: This is the map {name} uses with you.
home.resume: Pick up where you left off
home.putDownTitle: Okay. You can put this down.
home.putDownBody: Your place is saved on this phone. Come back when you're ready.

intro.whatBody: The map your therapist uses with you. It's for the moment you're in it.
intro.whatTherapist: It's the map {name} uses with you. It's for the moment you're in it.
intro.notBody: This is not therapy. It is not advice. It is not a crisis service.
intro.privacyBody: Nothing you tap leaves this phone.
intro.nameHelp: Only saved on this phone. Used when you share with them.

outcome.unmapped: This path isn't mapped yet — bring it to your next session.

share.wentBack: Questions I went back to and changed:
share.copiedFallback: Copied. You can paste it into a message to your therapist.

resource.notWritten: Your therapist hasn't written this part yet. Bring it to your next session.
resource.noLinksYet: Your therapist hasn't added these links yet. Bring it to your next session.

exercise.soundBody: Some exercises have soft sound. You can change this later.
exercise.iosHint: No sound? Check the switch on the side of your phone.

names.physiological-sigh: Double breath in, long breath out

grounding.tapToContinue: Tap anywhere when you're ready for the next one.
steps: Look around. Find five things you can see.
Find four things you can feel.
Listen. Find three things you can hear.
Find two things you can smell.
Find one thing you can taste.

about.title: About
about.deleteBody: This erases everything on this device: your place, your settings, and your therapist's name.
about.deleted: Everything on this device has been erased.
about.privacy: Nothing you tap leaves this phone. There are no accounts and no tracking.

review.title: Review the map
review.intro: Every question, every answer, and where it goes. Highlighted items are guesses from the photographed chart. Send corrections back using “Copy as text”.
review.unreachable: Can't be reached from the start ({count}):
review.loops: Loops (someone giving these answers goes round in a circle):
